notablePrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
